verse.verse_1: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
verse.verse_2: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
verse.verse_3: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
verse.verse_4: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
verse.verse_5: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
verse.verse_6: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
verse.verse_8: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
verse.verse_9: And the mountains will be like wool,
verse.verse_10: And no friend will ask after a friend,
verse.verse_11: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
verse.verse_14: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
verse.verse_15: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
verse.verse_16: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
verse.verse_17: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
verse.verse_18: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
verse.verse_19: Truly man was created very impatient;-
verse.verse_21: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
verse.verse_22: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
verse.verse_23: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
verse.verse_24: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
verse.verse_25: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
verse.verse_26: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
verse.verse_27: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
verse.verse_28: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
verse.verse_29: And those who guard their chastity,
verse.verse_30: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
verse.verse_31: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
verse.verse_32: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
verse.verse_33: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
verse.verse_34: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
verse.verse_35: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
verse.verse_36: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
verse.verse_37: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
verse.verse_38: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
verse.verse_39: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
verse.verse_40: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
verse.verse_41: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
verse.verse_42: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
verse.verse_43: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
verse.verse_44: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
